notes: Two dates per primary radar, pinned to each site's catalogued pair. Primary metrics use identical blocks with valid L, C, L30 and reference data; missing C is excluded. Geographic split fixed before processing; fitting and detector selection use training states only. Site bootstrap, 95% percentile intervals, shown for AUPRC. Stable false alarms use held-out stable sites only, not negatives in selected disturbance sites. Forest/fire/flood sites were selected for reference positives; this is not a random national prevalence survey. Crop labels mean cultivated land, not confirmed crop change. Per-class rows measure change detection within sites selected for that kind plus stable controls, not multiclass cause-label accuracy. Land-cover strata with at least two sites and 20 reference positives are reported alongside pooled rows. DSWx-S1 references use Sentinel-1 and are not sensor-independent flood truth. Fisher fusion assumes independence; Bonferroni is also reported. Logistic threshold is calibrated on training stable blocks, not a p-value or BH-FDR threshold. L_series uses more NISAR dates and is reported separately from the headline. The primary fusion headline compares unsupervised Fisher/Bonferroni with raw L/C. Supervised logistic fusion is compared separately against equally trained single-sensor controls.
